name: create-loaded-vibes

scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts context .agents package.json tsconfig.json pnpm-workspace.yaml README.md SECURITY.md CONTRIBUTING.md eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs tsdown.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts context .agents package.json tsconfig.json pnpm-workspace.yaml README.md SECURITY.md CONTRIBUTING.md eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs tsdown.config.ts vitest.config.ts
